headline: Abraham Ramirez shuts out a fourth opponent
dek: Cal State LA have won four times and have not yet conceded, with Abraham Ramirez making fourteen saves behind them. The conference's other unbeaten sides have all been scored on already.
displaced_by: Cal State LA's fourth win and fourth shutout; the standing three-win line is no longer true
